cases.name: Paisley Ann Marie-Nicole Brown
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Paisley was a bright light in the lives of those who knew her, filled with joy, laughter, and an infectious spirit. Though her time with us was tragically short, Paisley embodied a love that transcended her years. She brought joy to every birthday celebration with her enchanting voice, sharing her unique rendition of "Happy Birthday" that turned every occasion into a special memory. Those who were fortunate to know her would describe her as kind-hearted and joyful, traits that made her a cherished sister and a beloved playmate who adored playing princess and engaging in endless games with her siblings."
cases.narrative: He admitted to beating Paisley Brown while he was looking after her and four other children, and to binding Paisley's hands with a rope and her legs with tape, dropping her, and beating her.
